facts.text: Serve the mains when the friends take over the cooking on the trail.
facts.why: The plot has Cookie get drunk and send the chuck wagon over a cliff, breaking his legs. The friends carry the food in saddlebags, they do not take over the cooking.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Cookie sends the chuck wagon over the cliff.

facts.text: Eat up, city boy. Out here supper's beans and coffee, and you'll be grateful for both.
facts.why: Not a Curly line. His famous speech is 'One thing. Just one thing.' This one is printed in quote marks and its 'beans and coffee' talk is not in his dialogue.
Bonnie Rayburn is a fellow paying guest on the drive, not a cowhand. The ranch hands are Jeff and T.R.
facts.fix: Bonnie, a guest on the drive
